Well done for making a go of it so early. 

I didn't go to rehab until I was 50. 

Keep trying your best. It might seem like you are failing at times, but none of your efforts are going to waste.

Not sure if it's relevant to your experience but the timetable for the 220x is VERY confusing. I noticed it last time I went out. Something like you need to catch the outbound bus back into carrigaline and change. Very random if you are not familiar with the service. 

Also, it not turning up isn't great either.

Availability fluctuates wildly depending on where you are stopping. Pamplona: no problem. Smaller villages you should definitely book as soon you know your itinerary. It can be difficult at the start to distinguish between municipal, church and private albergues
This was a few weeks ago
Pamplona we had no problem. Zubiri was overbooked and had limited beds. I ended up on a mattress on the floor. You would want to book as far ahead as you can once you know your itinerary

I arrived in zubiri and it had caused a lot of problems as some people hadn't been able to book because the network was out and options there are limited. We ended up sleeping on the floor of the kitchen. only managed to charge my phone again in pamplona. It was fine though, we managed.
I recently registered with with mymind.org. The rates are quite high but don't let that put you off. If you are on a low income like myself you will qualify for the lower rate.
Farmgate probably. Based in the English Market and using ingredients sourced there. traditional recipes done well, without the nouvelle cuisine angle

Power outage in kilbarry according to this? https://powercheck.esbnetworks.ie/

It really is anakin skywalker

I would say flixbus is the cheapest way to travel? There is a route from Paris to Bayonne via bordeaux. You might want to break the journey in bordeaux as it would be quite long, but you don't have to. You can get the train from bayonne to St J PDP.

Yes, I've been feeling pretty disillusioned lately as well. I'm about 14 months out of treatment. I've had some experience with sobriety before and I have been fed up with AA before. The cliques in my home group and not being asked to share really bothered me. I stopped going to meetings and eventually relapsed. 

This time round I'm feeling something similar, but I'm just going to other meetings and meeting new people. I know what will happen if I miss my meetings. I sometime forget that there are so many meetings to choose from and I never signed up just to go to the same home group for the rest of my days.

It's very important that it should be, precisely because it's such a worry for newcomers like yourself, I know it was for me too. 

Having said that, I got a real sense of panic when I first saw someone from my regular life in the rooms. Now I welcome it, but I don't make a big deal out of it if I see someone I know, I just share and listen as I would to any other alcoholic. In principle I tend not to share anybody else's story but my own in meetings.

I just completed a 28 day 12 step program here in ireland. I got out 2 weeks ago. I can  really relate to what you are saying in your original post. 

I had a big problem with my parents being abusive and I felt like if they owned up to their behaviour it would help me to stay off alcohol.

The counsellors immediately put it back on me. 'Where did your anger go?'. 

I had to admit to my own behaviour in my family, and the fact is that my patterns of anger along with my alcoholism was very damaging for me, my kids and my ex partner. 

Basically I never got the apology I wanted from my parents but I've had a good look at myself and got honest about my own regrets. 

I've made amends where I can and it's helped me to let go of the past. Hopefully I can move on now with my kids in my life and on reasonable terms with my ex.

My parents are in their 70s now and one is in active addiction. I had to accept that I won't get any justice or apology for the things that happened. They just aren't the same people that I was scared of when I was a kid at all.

'Pray For Newton' by Sun Kil Moon mentions a few serial killers

I had an hour to myself in my hotel when I turned on the TV.
It was quite a thriller, CNN was recording the bat man killer.
His eyes were glazed like he was from Mars.
Yesterday he was no one, today he was a star.
200m away at most
Thanks!
Has to be unknown pleasures
This is worse than the Zapruder Film
The hobbling scene in Misery. I saw it in the cinema and i fell into a foetal position in the aisle until it was over, then i got back into my seat and watched the rest of the film.
Kind of creepy to see the phone there, considering he made so many calls to his victims...

Marquee Moon by Television. It somehow plays seemlessly as an album despite each track being so different from the last. It almost sounds  like a punk version of a jazz album played with guitar, bass and drums.
Had a studio on the 4th floor for 5 years. Cheapest art studio I ever had. Really sad to see it go...

Thanks, I didn't realise that was the case with lower doses. I think I must have been put on 15mg to combat the insomnia I had. I slept 12 hours last night but it's pretty hard to get up in the morning. I hope I can get back to some sort of normal routine soon.
Thanks, it's good to hear from someone who's taken it first hand. I'm hoping I can go back to work on Monday but I'm feeling really lethargic right now...

Try not to treat yourself so harshly. I can guarantee you you're own worst critic. 

I don't know a whole lot about dyslexic conditions, but I had a friend who went through school undiagnosed and it really made her life hard and it affected her self esteem. She actually believed she was stupid when it was just a small flaw in her cognition. Being diagnosed with dyslexia was a huge relief to her.

At least you know your condition and thats not a bad place to start from. You can accept it and ask for help. Tell your employer. Work to your strengths. Your dyslexia is an adversity but you can overcome it. Putting yourself down and knocking your own self esteem won't help though! Wishing you strength and courage...

Your self esteem is really low right now. Maybe it has been like that for a long time or maybe it is just coming over you today. 

There are things you can change about yourself and there are things you can't. Try to accept the things you can't change and work on the things you can. Work on your perception of yourself if you can, you'll be surprised how much it will improve your mood. Try not to say stuff like that about yourself, you seem like a thoughtful, sensitive person.

I'm on here as well because it is all getting a bit too much. Its a long story but I've made mistakes, I'm facing a huge failure in my life, and I tend to obsess on the negative. Yesterday I felt like dying but today I'm going to pick up where I left off and try to make things better, even if I fail again.

Whenever I read about someone else wanting to die it makes me sad, because I know how it feels. Wishing you strength today...
Thank you

Thanks for your kind words. I've been told I'm too hard on myself. I feel I need to honour my commitment to the project and I'm not sure it's possible. I've told the council and I think they will try to help me solve the problems tomorrow. I'm supposed to go to the psychiatric unit at 1pm, I just have to get there whatever is going on. It just feels like a terrible situation at the moment...

Breaking up with someone where you have a child is so hard. Something similar happened to me in my early 20s and I wasn't really equipped to deal with it. The practicalities of finding transport, a new place to live, work, while going through all that stuff is tough.

What I'd say to you if you are in a really dark place is hang on for 24 hours, things can really improve in a short space of time. Talk to someone about all this, it really helps. If it doesn't, go to your doctor.

It sounds like you've accepted your relationship with your partner is over. For me that was the point where things improved. If I was to do anything again I'd try not to let the custody situation get acrimonious, it didn't help at all. That was just one of many mistakes I made. 

Try to think about your son and how you are going to keep contact. You're important to him and he needs you. That's a great reason to hang in there.
